effectQuote: Running along her perfectly shaped arm was the tiniest, most miniscule of breaks.

holderQuote: The Goblin rose, pointing at Zel’s chest—
The undead warrior regarded Pisces. It lifted the halberd it was carrying and saluted him. Pisces lifted his rapier—then lowered it, sniffed, and spat in the street.
effectQuote: [Bone Fracture]. Or some variation of the spell. It had torn apart the bones, fractured then shattered them in an instant. The kind of spell no one knew because it didn’t work on living people—only one kind of person would learn that spell.
